title: Nectar robbing in Collaea cipoensis (Fabaceae), an endemic shrub of the Brazilian rupestrian grasslands
decision_basis: Primary study quantifies robbery frequency and relates robbery damage to visitation/flower abortion, but does not model independently measured floral access geometry as the predictor of robbery route use.
notes: Tubular corolla is system description, not the tested robbery predictor.

title: Pollination ecology of Clerodendrum inerme (L.) Gaertn. (Lamiaceae) in Coringa mangrove ecosystem, Andhra Pradesh, India
decision_basis: Natural-history/pollination study describes a long hairy corolla and identifies primary nectar robbers, but does not provide a quantitative geometry-to-robbery comparison or model.
notes: Morphological specialization is descriptive context only.

title: Zoophily and nectar-robbing by sunbirds in Gardenia latifolia Ait. (Rubiaceae)
decision_basis: Study describes narrow corolla tubes, concealed nectar and sunbird robbing but does not quantitatively test variation in access geometry against robbery probability/frequency.
notes: Descriptive route biology without geometry predictor test.

title: NECTAR ROBBING BY THE RED-TAILED COMET SAPPHO SPARGANURUS: THE VALUE OF CITIZEN SCIENCE TO DOCUMENT INFREQUENT BEHAVIOR IN BIRDS
decision_basis: Citizen-science study estimates occurrence of nectar robbing by Red-tailed Comets but does not test floral or visitor-flower access geometry as a predictor of route choice.
notes: Behavior occurrence record, not access-geometry test.

title: Passerine birds supporting cross pollination in Erythrina stricta Roxb.
decision_basis: Pollination natural-history study characterizes bird visitation and floral biology but does not provide a quantitative access-geometry-to-robbery relation.
notes: No eligible direct geometry-route estimate recovered.
